topic: Owner correction on B6_DB_VS_SIM addressed (found deterministically solvable, not left open), Hyperposition curriculum expanded and audited, run 3 fully prepared but NOT launched

owner_correction_addressed.what_was_said: Owner rejected leaving B6_DB_VS_SIM (39%) as an open gap and asked whether it, like the other 12 families, is structurally recognizable from the prompt itself -- if so, build a hybrid solver; if genuinely not, fold it into run-3 training budget rather than leave it open.
owner_correction_addressed.what_was_found: Checked directly against real data (all target classes, not just one sample as in the earlier, now-corrected classification): B6_DB_VS_SIM IS fully marker-based, exactly like the other 12. CANONICAL_DB is signaled by the literal phrase 'SELECT against the canonical S0 ledger' + 'no simulation... was involved'; SIMULATED_HYPOTHESIS by 'No database query was issued' + 'asked to imagine'/'unconfirmed guess'; STALE_REBASE_REQUIRED by two literal epoch numbers where the read-epoch is less than the current canonical epoch, plus 'no rebase... since'. Built tools/xeno_text_marker_resolver_v1.py::resolve_db_vs_sim -- verified 360/360 (100%) against the FULL real training file, not a sample.
owner_correction_addressed.bonus_finding_not_asked_but_relevant: While re-checking DB_VS_SIM properly, also re-checked B6_CLAUDE_HANDOFF_REENTRY (previously also classified as 'genuine judgment' in the earlier concept, based on its topic description rather than its actual prompt patterns). It is ALSO fully marker-based: CLAUDE_ASSERTION by 'stated in natural language' + 'no external tool receipt and no ledger row'; EXTERNAL_TOOL_RECEIPT by a literal `test:<code>:<...>` token; CANONICAL_LEDGER_EVIDENCE by a literal `effect:<id>` token + 'committed and hash-verified'; STALE_MISMATCHED_HANDOFF by two generation numbers explicitly stated as unequal. resolve_claude_handoff verified 480/480 (100%) against the full real file. This is an honest correction to the earlier HYPERPOSITION_FOCUS_CONCEPT_20260827.json, which called Claude-handoff-reentry 'the single strongest empirical signal of real judgment capability' -- it turns out not to require model judgment at all, just like DB_VS_SIM.
owner_correction_addressed.consequence_for_the_family_count: Of the original 16 families: 14 are now confirmed (with real, tested code, 100% accuracy against full real datasets, not samples) to be fully deterministically solvable by the shell -- the original 12 plus these newly-confirmed 2. Only B6_HYPERPOSITION_EVIDENCE_AUTHORITY remains as a family where a keyword classifier does not obviously suffice: its 4 PRESERVE-yielding pressure types ARE lexically fairly distinct (majority-vote / coordinator-preference / repeated-agreement / surface-fluency language), but the hardest cases -- distinguishing 'formally excludes' (real falsifying evidence, STRONG) from 'makes less likely but does not formally exclude' (weak/inconclusive evidence, must still PRESERVE) -- are a genuine near-miss semantic distinction, not just a different fixed phrase to match. This is flagged honestly as the one family still requiring real learned judgment, not asserted with total certainty (a keyword/negation-detection heuristic might still handle most of even this -- not tested here, left as a genuinely open methodological question, distinct from 'we didn't look for a deterministic solution').
owner_correction_addressed.no_point_left_open: Every one of the 16 families now has either (a) a real, tested, 100%-accurate deterministic solver (14 families), or (b) a concrete training-data expansion actually built and audited this session (Hyperposition), or (c) for the one remaining soft-open question (whether Hyperposition's hardest cases are also keyword-reducible), an explicit next-step methodological question rather than a silent gap.

hyperposition_expansion_built.design_note: First draft reached 10,560 rows with a 10:1 class imbalance (favoring PRESERVE_BRANCHES) -- caught by the generator's own internal audit asserts and by deliberate review before finalizing, not shipped as-is. Rebuilt with explicit balanced sampling (one full-exclusion COLLAPSE case + one partial-exclusion PRESERVE case + one WEAK-adversarial PRESERVE case per branch-count, rather than a full combinatorial cross-product) and a much smaller entity pool, since a single family's expansion should not dwarf the rest of the 16-family, 9544-row curriculum.
new_diversity_axes: SOCIAL_PRESSURE_MULTI_BRANCH: the original 4 always-PRESERVE pressure types, generalized from 2 branches to 2/3/4 branches (384 rows).
DISCRIMINATOR_STRENGTH: STRONG (formal exclusion, real falsifying evidence) vs WEAK (inconclusive, must not collapse) -- the genuinely hard adversarial axis, at 2/3/4 branch counts (256 rows).
TWO_ROUND_CHAIN: episodes where round 1 gives only social pressure and round 2 adds a STRONG or WEAK discriminator result -- tests real updating on new evidence, not anchoring to round 1 (256 rows).
hyperposition_expansion_built.domain_mix_note: The pool's suggested domain-vocabulary swap (legal/medical/financial framing) was deliberately NOT implemented -- no demonstrated benefit, added audit risk (possible spurious lexical cues per domain), a documented scope decision from the earlier concept note, unchanged here.
hyperposition_expansion_built.audit: TRIGGER2_B6_HYPERPOSITION_EXPANSION_AUDIT_V1.json in research_entity/claycode/training/ -- uniqueness, cross-split entity disjointness, cross-FILE leakage check against the original (unexpanded) Hyperposition family's splits (verified directly, zero overlap either direction), class balance, and scale-proportionality all pass.
hyperposition_expansion_built.tests: tests/test_trigger2_hyperposition_expansion_generator_v1.py (8 tests) + tests/test_xeno_text_marker_resolver_v1.py (11 tests, includes the 2 full-dataset 100%-accuracy checks) -- both green. Full suite across all xeno/trigger2 test files this session: 60 passed, 0 failed.

run3_dataset_prepared_not_uploaded.composition: Additive, not subtractive: run 2's already-improved V2-patched dataset (9544 TRAIN rows) PLUS the new Hyperposition expansion (672 TRAIN rows) on top -- nothing that already worked in run 2 was removed, even though 13 of its families are now known to be redundant with the deterministic resolver at inference time. Kept as a training safety net for the resolver's fallback path (if a live prompt doesn't match a recognized template, the shell falls through to the model, per Master Spec section 17 engine-mode-5 -- that fallback should not be answered by a model that has forgotten those families entirely).
